summary: Reclassify historical model-28 receipts and publish current bounded route and high-speed performance evidence

physics.reason: The current evidence fixtures exercise the existing 120 Hz solver and tuning without changing production physics or model identity.

world.reason: The audit and benchmark use the existing Standard v15 generator, source-validated physical archive and production scenery; no generation code or recipe changes.

data.reason: Historical receipts remain byte-preserved provenance and new current receipts are documentation evidence, not runtime save, replay, race or cache formats.

mountains.reason: No production mountain data or recipe changed; the current evidence records the existing v15 Standard archive identity.

races.reason: Route probes are unranked automated fixtures and do not write race data.

records.reason: Evidence runs do not write personal records.

ghosts.reason: Evidence runs use synthetic bounded control and do not create or migrate ghosts.

caches.reason: The guarded runs read the existing source/engine-validated physical and preparation caches without baking or changing cache formats.

outstanding_acceptance: Rendered visual inspection, ordinary controller handling, full-route skiability and player/controller performance acceptance remain separate from the new automated and bounded performance receipts.
The focus-lost first performance batch was rejected and is retained only as diagnostic artifact evidence; the fresh focused batch is the sole current performance receipt.
